slides.subtitle: We've hired a lot of them at The Kiln. Here's what works.

slides.body: Super technical, aren't constrained by no-code tools, understand the code-level roots of everything they're building. Hire when you want robust, cutting-edge automations beyond outbound and CRM enrichment. You'll carry the GTM strategy yourself.

Deep understanding of the tools that plug into Clay (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong). Hire when you have a complex CRM and need Clay-to-CRM integration done right. Watch for tool-loyalty: they may resist switching.

Fundamental grasp of GTM strategy and what sales teams actually want from automation. Amazing in client-facing and stakeholder work. Hire when you need sales strategy in-house. Expect a learning curve on the technical side.
New to GTM, obsessed with automation, building with cutting-edge AI tools. Personally, this is where the most creative builds I've seen are coming from right now.

slides.subtitle: All four personas live at The Kiln.
